name: Key Steps to a Perfectly Painted Garage

step.name: Step 1
step.text: Getting a great paint finish in your garage doesn't just happen — it’s all about following a few key steps! Here's how we typically approach it:

step.name: Step 2
step.text: Step 1: Prep the Surface. This is crucial! Before any paint touches the walls, we make sure any drywall repairs are done, seams are smooth, and screws are properly set and mudded. A perfectly level and clean surface is your foundation for a flawless finish.

step.name: Step 3
step.text: Step 2: Prime, Prime, Prime! Never skip the primer, especially on new or repaired drywall. We use a high-quality drywall or PVA-type primer to seal the surface, ensure even absorption, and provide a good base for the topcoat. This really helps the final paint job look uniform and vibrant.

step.name: Step 4
step.text: Step 3: Apply Durable Topcoats. Once the primer is dry, we apply a durable interior topcoat. For garages, we often recommend a satin or semi-gloss latex paint because it’s super easy to clean and stands up well to scuffs and general wear. We usually do two coats for the best coverage and longevity.

step.name: Step 5
step.text: Step 4: Consider the Timing. While painting isn't usually tied to permits, it's often part of a bigger finishing project. We make sure that all wiring, storage systems, and other finish work are complete before the final paint goes on to avoid damage or rework.

step.name: Step 6
step.text: Step 5: Inspect and Finish. We do a thorough inspection to catch any missed spots or imperfections, ensuring you get a clean, professional look.

step.name: Step 7
step.text: Following these steps helps us deliver a garage paint job that's not just pretty, but tough enough for real garage life. Want a professional finish for your garage? Contact HH Remodeling LLC!
